name: Ben Shelton

observed.title: Carlos Alcaraz vs Ben Shelton Title Battle | Paris 2026 Final Highlights
observed.camera: broadcast (high, wide) plus close-ups between points

appearance.hair: dark brown, wavy, over the headband

forehand.finish: big and high: racket ends up over the right shoulder with the left arm high (left-handed, so his forehand is on his left)

backhand.stance: open stance on the run to his right
backhand.takeback: low, racket head below the hands behind the right hip
backhand.contact: beside the front hip while lunging
backhand.finish: high over the left shoulder, both hands on

running.ready: very wide receiving stance, knees bent
running.firstStep: big lean and long drive step toward the ball
running.recovery: settles back into a wide stance quickly

mannerisms: roars with the racket held low after big points (v2 120.0)

gameHints.player-artist: All dark navy kit, white headband, white wristband, white shoes and socks; left-handed, so the racket is in the left hand; colourful racket frame.
gameHints.racket-coach: Left-handed: mirror the swing. Two-handed backhand: low takeback, high finish over the left shoulder.
gameHints.animator: Very wide, low receiving stance and a deep split step; long, driving first strides.

notSeen: serve (the main reason people know him; not studied here)
a sharp forehand takeback and contact
